deviations.what: Omitted the “Get 32% Discount” + promo code section
deviations.why: The product has no promotion/discount model and the source contained no verifiable data behind the offer.

deviations.what: Omitted the “Hurry Up!” circular offer card and the booking form
deviations.why: Booking is not a supported flow in Vitrina, and urgency claims were not backed by real data.
Team sections only accept REAL_OWNER_PERSON data; no verified barber identities exist in the data contract.

deviations.what: Adapted branch addresses into a single service-area string
deviations.why: The data contract provides d.AREAS as a string, not a structured branch array, so three-column branch cards cannot be built faithfully.
Unbounded is not in the self-hosted font list; Fira Sans Condensed/Manrope are used as the closest available condensed display pairing.

notes: Faithful Vitrina port of Templatemo Barber Shop: fixed mustard sidebar, gradient hero over imagery, image service cards with price pills, dot-leader price list, and an accent open-hours card. All media and visible copy resolve only through the provided data contract fields.
